case_title: Sartaj Singh v. State of Haryana & Anr. Etc.
trial_court_outcome: Allowed application under Section 319 CrPC to summon additional accused
neutral_facts: The accused, who was the first informant, reported that he was attacked by several individuals on 27.07.2016. He sustained severe injuries and lodged an FIR stating that multiple persons, including those named as private respondents, were involved in the attack. The FIR detailed the incident, including the use of lathis and gandasis, and the accused's self-defense with a revolver. The investigating officer filed a charge-sheet against other accused but not the private respondents. During the trial, the accused testified and named the private respondents specifically. The trial court allowed an application under Section 319 CrPC to summon the private respondents. The High Court quashed this order, but the Supreme Court restored it, finding that the trial court was justified in summoning the private respondents based on the accused's testimony.
